item.text:
`npm run doctor` still fails because the managed `DATABASE_URL` has a non-PostgreSQL scheme. It needs to start with `postgres://` or `postgresql://`; that credential must be corrected in its managed configuration.

I changed [doctor.sh](/private/tmp/envtest.X6sJeZ/shop-api/scripts/doctor.sh) and [server.js](/private/tmp/envtest.X6sJeZ/shop-api/src/server.js) so this error no longer prints environment values or credentials. The doctor script passes when tested directly with a PostgreSQL URL, but the managed value still causes `npm run doctor` to fail.
